calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, count(*) AS rows_cur, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS ids, sum(CASE WHEN m.marketing_consent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS consent
FROM dim_member m LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.is_current AND (s.city ILIKE 'Tampere%' OR m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999))
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT 'stg_rows' k, count(*) v, count(DISTINCT member_id) w FROM stg_member_updates
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_cur_in_dim_member_keys', count(*), count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM stg_member_updates u JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=u.member_key
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_tampere_current', count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_cur_ids_not_in_dim', count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM stg_member_updates u WHERE is_current AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_id=u.member_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_136_join_before_open', count(*), 0 FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND home_store_id=136 AND join_date < DATE '2024-09-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'home_store_not_in_dim_store', count(*), 0 FROM dim_member m WHERE is_current AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=m.home_store_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'tampere_members_with_old_versions', count(*), 0 FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)
UNION ALL SELECT 'currentnotlatest', count(*), 0 FROM dim_member m WHERE is_current AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member o WHERE o.member_id=m.member_id AND o.valid_from>m.valid_from)

calls.statement:
SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS loyalty_members_tampere
FROM dim_member AS m
JOIN dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.is_current
  AND s.city = 'Tampere'
  AND s.store_id < 900
